user.title: Connect your Grilla account
user.description: Sign in with your Grilla / Alpha Connect app account. Your password is used once to obtain a token and is not stored.

data_description.email: The email address for your Grilla app account.
data_description.password: Your Grilla app password (used once to get a refresh token; not stored).

models.title: Choose your grill model
models.description: Pick the **model** for each grill below — this sets the device's model in Home Assistant (the grill keeps its own name). Choose from the list or type a custom value, and change it later under **Configure**.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect. Please try again.

abort.already_configured: This Grilla account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: Those credentials are for a different Grilla account than this entry.

init.title: Grilla options
init.description: Update the **model** shown for each grill — this is the device's model in Home Assistant, not its name. Choose from the list or type a custom value.
